### We Publish New Businesses Every Monday

#### Enter your email below to be the first "In the Know"

Online businesses have emerged as a driving force behind the global economy. With the rise of eCommerce, the increase in remote work, and the widespread adoption of digital technology across various industries, entrepreneurs and investors are seeking money-making opportunities in the online space.

If you’re considering buying an established online business, you’re not alone—there’s a growing demand for internet businesses for sale, and we offer a wide selection of profitable online business listings for aspiring owners.

The online business space is incredibly diverse, providing many opportunities for those looking to enter the market. From Shopify stores and Software as a Service (SaaS) businesses to content-based websites and mobile applications, our marketplace is brimming with potential ventures catering to various interests and skill sets.

As more people recognize the appeal of a location-independent lifestyle and the potential for rapid growth, the market for online businesses continues to flourish.

We’ve helped thousands of entrepreneurs and investors like you buy online businesses and websites, so follow along closely as we equip you with the essential knowledge and resources necessary to make informed decisions when navigating the market.

## Why Choose a Full-Service Brokerage like Empire Flippers?

At Empire Flippers, we have the privilege of making deals for a living. This experience has allowed us to grow a team that’s specialized in full-service M&A brokerage. Whether you’re interested in buying a small business or an eight-figure business, we have a dedicated team for each step of the process.

This process begins before businesses even make it to our marketplace. Our vetting team vets all the businesses that apply to our marketplace to ensure the high quality remains.

You may have noticed that we only list businesses that are already turning over a profit. This means you get a turnkey business that earns you money from the first day you get the keys. We reject the majority of business owners who apply to list on our marketplace for this very reason.

Buying a business can be a daunting prospect, especially if you haven’t done it before. Going into it alone can leave you with a lot of work to get through. That’s why you’ll work with our sales team to not only help you find the perfect business opportunity but also guide you through the buying process.

Many people think the buying process ends with having an offer accepted. While it’s one of the biggest steps to acquiring a new business, there’s still a lot of work to be done. Transferring the asset from the original business owner to the new one can be challenging, especially for people with little experience in online business.

That’s why everyone who buys with Empire Flippers gets to use our dedicated migrations team, who will take care of transferring your new business to you. Not all brokerage firms offer this, but we feel such an important stage of buying a business deserves high-end care.
